findings: Setup u32 priority narrows to u8 render_priority before comparison. Max link narrows max+1 to u8.
Tail-search setup appends after equals; MaxSorted/head-search relocation inserts before equals.
GXReorder inserts without detaching or comparing priorities; predecessor need not have strictly different priority.
Remove retains render_cb; relocation retains callback. MoveBefore copies byte metadata before remove; when other==gobj, cleared predecessor causes insertion at head, not before itself.
Two source-only helpers GObj_GXFindPrioPosition and get_by_prio take HSD_GObj* and return HSD_GObj*.
